.. _TTL:

TTL
===

Returns the current Time to Live (TTL) of an audio stream.

Arguments
---------

+-------------+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| Name        | Type       | Description                                                   |
+=============+============+===============================================================+
| stream_id   | ``string`` | ASCII ID of the audio stream.                                 |
+-------------+------------+---------------------------------------------------------------+

Input
-----

+----------+--------------------------------------------+
| Type     | Description                                |
+==========+============================================+
| ``null`` | N/A                                        |
+----------+--------------------------------------------+

Output
------

+----------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Type     | Description                                                                                            |
+==========+========================================================================================================+
| ``int``  | Returns -1 if no TTL has been set for the audio stream. Otherwise, returns the current TTL in seconds. |
+----------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Example
-------

.. code-block:: none

   TTL 'vocals'
